warm: file read once before the clock
cold: drop_caches after warmup, before the timed read
notes: OVITO 3.17.2 reads extended XYZ periodicity and an out-of-cell second frame without wrapping or repeating frame 0.
A timed write is rejected unless its file is non-empty, inside that format's size range, and reads back at the full atom count. That check runs after the clock stops.

h2h10 printed readcon-con and chemfiles-con writes as 0.0794 s. The raw samples differ (readcon 0.079409, chemfiles 0.079377); four decimal places hid that. Chemfiles has no CON writer. Its write copies coordinates into a Frame. Both rows stored the readcon CON size, 45378064, which is not chemfiles' output. The interleaved fresh-process write was slower than a back-to-back write_columns loop. This table's 1M readcon-con write is that back-to-back serial measurement, 0.0744 s. Default threads are 0.0629 s. chemfiles-con has no writer, so its write cell is 'no writer'.
chemfiles has no native CON format; the chemfiles-con row copies positions and the cell out of a chemfiles Frame filled from readcon.
chemfiles compression library /tmp/chemfiles-install/lib/libchemfiles.so opens {"bz2": true, "gz": true, "trr": true, "xz": true}
MDAnalysis 2.11.0 on DCD, XTC, NetCDF, TRR, XYZ and PDB. Cells are orthogonal, so the 2.11 triclinic wrap does not apply.

mdcompress 2.0.5 (refresh-bio). 1.0.0 is not on PyPI and this row is not relabeled as 1.0.0. Archive preset, one thread. The clock compresses a DCD that is already on disk, and the read queries one frame at a time. A one-frame trajectory cannot be read ('Cannot read first frame' on DCD, XTC and TRR), so those rows are unsupported. The binding views the float64 box as float32; the cell is read from those bytes as float64.

readcon-con, readcon-con-gz, readcon-con-zst, readcon-chemfiles and readcon-conbin writes were measured again on d4347f39 after the short-decimal tie spelling and the unnamed-file publish. Reads and every other write are the earlier run on this machine, same protocol: serial, taskset -c 0-7, one warmup, n=6, and n=12 when IQR/median exceeded 5%. The harness unlinks the destination and does not pass rewrite=True, so the ranked rewrite path is not in these rows.
